app.title: Giveaways
app.openFromBot: Open this app from the bot: tap the menu button in the chat with the bot.
form.postLinkHelp: In the channel, open the post menu, tap Copy Link and paste it here.
form.created: Giveaway created. The join button is on the post.
details.title: Giveaway
details.moveHelp: Paste the link to another post of the same channel. Participants stay.
details.finishText: Winners are drawn within a minute. This cannot be undone.
details.finishing: The draw starts within a minute.
details.cancelText: The join button leaves the post. Participants stay, and you can restore it later.
details.restored: Giveaway restored. The join button is back on the post.
review.title: Results review
review.publishText: The results are posted as a reply to the giveaway post. After that, winners cannot change.
review.skipText: The results are not posted, and the review closes for good.
error.unauthorized: The session has expired. Close the app and open it again from the bot.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid: Something in the form is not right. Check the fields.
error.not_yours: Only the admin who created this giveaway can change it.
error.finished: The winners are drawn, so this giveaway cannot change.
error.not_admin: You are not an admin of this channel.
error.bot_no_rights: The bot cannot edit posts in this channel. Give it the “Post messages” and “Edit messages of others” permissions.
error.exists: You already have a giveaway on this post.
error.taken: Another giveaway is already on this post.
error.invalid_post_link: This is not a link to a channel post the bot can see.
error.end_in_past: Choose a time in the future.
error.other_channel: A giveaway can only move to a post of the same channel.
error.due: The giveaway has ended and is being drawn, so it cannot move.
error.stale: Someone changed this giveaway. The latest version is shown.
error.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
error.review_closed: These results were already published or closed.
error.published_partly: Some result messages could not be posted. Check the channel.
